extDescription.message: Pauses the dangerous actions scammers push people into and asks someone you trust.

profile_elder_hint.message: Stops remote access tricks, fake virus alerts and dangerous commands.

profile_child_hint.message: Also asks before installing programs from unofficial sites.

welcome_subtitle.message: Choose one. You can change it later.

contact_title.message: Who should they ask if something looks wrong?

contact_title__self.message: Who can you ask in a tricky moment?

contact_subtitle.message: When ScamFuse stops something, the pause screen shows a button that opens a chat with this person. Nothing is sent by itself.

contact_subtitle__self.message: Optional. You can add this later in settings.

field_who_hint.message: As it should read on the button: “Ask Dad”.

field_pin.message: PIN to unlock (only you should know it)

pin_hint_none.message: Without a PIN, “Continue anyway” opens after 15 seconds.

pin_hint_set.message: With a PIN, a stopped action waits for your PIN or for 30 minutes.

err_phone.message: Enter the number with the country code, e.g. +44 7700 900123.

err_pin.message: The PIN must be 4 to 6 digits.

done_point_stop.message: If a site tries something dangerous, ScamFuse stops it and shows a pause screen.

done_point_ask.message: On that screen there is a button: “Ask {name}”.

done_point_ask_none.message: You can add someone to ask later in settings.

done_point_private.message: ScamFuse does not send anything by itself and does not collect your browsing history.

done_show.message: Show this screen to the person you are protecting, so they know what the pause screen means.

done_pin_icon.message: Tip: pin the icon. Click the puzzle piece next to the address bar, then the pin next to ScamFuse.

btn_try_demo.message: Try it on the demo page

what_remote_site.message: This site offers a program that lets another person control your computer.

what_remote_download.message: You are downloading a program that lets another person control your computer.

what_clipboard.message: This site tried to slip a computer command into your clipboard. We removed it.

what_clipboard__child.message: This site wanted you to paste a command into your computer. That is how accounts get stolen. We removed it.

what_fake_alert.message: This page pretends your computer is infected. It is a scam.

what_program_download.message: You are downloading a program from an unofficial site.

what_program_download__child.message: Programs from unofficial sites often steal game accounts and passwords.

rule_remote_site.message: Banks, police and support services never ask you to install such programs.

rule_remote_download.message: Banks, police and support services never ask you to install such programs.

rule_clipboard.message: Real websites never ask you to paste commands into Windows or Terminal.

rule_fake_alert.message: Microsoft, Apple and your bank never show such pages and never ask you to call.

rule_program_download.message: If someone you do not know asked you to install it, stop.

rule_program_download__child.message: Install programs together with your parents.

ask_missing.message: No one to ask yet. Add them in settings.

continue_strict.message: Locked until {time}. Enter the PIN to open it now.

pin_locked.message: Too many attempts. Try again after {time}.

reason_cmd.message: A command for the Windows command line

reason_mshta.message: A command that runs a program from the internet

reason_pipe_to_shell.message: A command that downloads and runs a script

reason_shell_c.message: A command for the system shell

reason_msiexec.message: A command that installs a program

reason_download_run.message: A command that downloads and runs code

reason_hidden_window.message: A command that runs in a hidden window

reason_system_tool.message: A Windows tool often used by attackers

reason_base64_decode.message: A command that unpacks hidden code

reason_unix_exec_prep.message: A command that makes a file runnable

reason_network_address.message: An internet address inside the command

reason_fake_verification_comment.message: A fake “I am not a robot” note inside the command

reason_hidden_padding.message: Spaces that hide part of the command

reason_hidden_write.message: The site copied the text secretly

reason_run_instructions.message: The page tells you to press Win+R or open Terminal

reason_fake_captcha.message: A fake “I am not a robot” check

reason_fullscreen.message: The page took over the whole screen

reason_keyboard_lock.message: The page tried to lock the keyboard

reason_dialog_loop.message: The page kept opening warning windows

reason_history_trap.message: The page blocks the Back button

reason_remote_site.message: The site of a remote access program

reason_unofficial_program.message: A program from an unofficial site

msg_intro.message: Hi! ScamFuse stopped something suspicious on my computer.

msg_intro_page.message: Hi! Can you check this site for me?

msgwhat_remote_site.message: a site of a remote access program

msgwhat_remote_download.message: an attempt to install a remote access program

msgwhat_clipboard.message: a site slipped a command into my clipboard

msgwhat_program_download.message: a program from an unofficial site

clip_safe.message: # ScamFuse removed a dangerous command here. Do not run what a website asked you to paste.
clip_safe.description: Replaces a malicious command in the clipboard. Must start with # and must not contain quotes, | & < > or $.

opt_locked_text.message: Settings are protected with a PIN.

mode_strict.message: Strict: waits for the PIN or for the lock time

mode_strict_needs_pin.message: Set a PIN to use the strict mode.

opt_lock_minutes.message: Lock time in strict mode, minutes

det_remoteAccess_hint.message: AnyDesk, TeamViewer and similar: the most common start of a bank scam.

det_clipboard_hint.message: Fake “I am not a robot” checks that ask you to paste a command.

det_fakeAlert_hint.message: Pages that lock the screen and ask you to call “support”.

det_programDownload_hint.message: Cheats, mods and cracked games. Official stores are not affected.

opt_sites_hint.message: ScamFuse never stops anything on these sites.

err_site.message: Enter a site address, e.g. example.com.

about_text.message: Open source. The log stays on this computer. Messages are sent only when someone presses the button.

relay_sent.message: Message sent to {names}. Waiting for an answer…

relay_queued.message: No internet. The message will go as soon as the connection is back.

relay_blocked.message: {name}: not allowed. You can close this page.

ask_via_telegram.message: Sends an alert to their Telegram.

code_hint.message: They see a 6-digit code in Telegram. If they decide it is safe, they will read it to you by phone.

what_screen_share.message: This site asks to see your screen. A stranger would see your passwords and bank codes.

what_card_entry.message: This site asks for bank card details.

what_card_entry__child.message: This site asks for bank card details. Purchases are made together with parents.

rule_screen_share.message: Banks and support services never ask to see your screen.

rule_card_entry.message: If someone asked you to pay or “confirm” a card, stop and call.

msgwhat_screen_share.message: a site asks to see my screen

msgwhat_card_entry.message: a site asks for bank card details

reason_screen_share.message: The site asked to share the screen

reason_card_number.message: A bank card number was typed

det_screenShare_hint.message: Zoom, Google Meet, Teams and other meeting services are not affected.

det_cardEntry_hint.message: Asks before any purchase. Useful for children.

tg_text.message: Connect the trusted person's Telegram: alerts reach them by themselves, and they can allow or block an action from their phone.

tg_scan.message: Scan this code with the phone camera of the person who will get alerts.

tg_or_code.message: Or open @{bot} in Telegram and send the code {code}

tg_waiting.message: Waiting for the connection… The code works for 10 minutes.

tg_error.message: The alert server is not available. Check the internet and try again.

opt_relay_hint.message: Leave it as it is unless you run your own server.

opt_relay_none.message: No alert server is set. Messages go only with the “Ask” button.

err_relay_url.message: Enter an address that starts with https://.

opt_voice_hint.message: The browser reads the warning in its own voice.
